sloka: किं नु मे सीतया कार्यं किं कार्यं जीवितेन वा ।शयानं यो ऽद्य पश्यामि भ्रातरं युधि निर्जितम् ।। ६.४९.५ ।।।।
transliteration: kiṁ nu me sītayā kāryaṁ kiṁ kāryaṁ jīvitena vā ।śayānaṁ yo 'dya paśyāmi bhrātaraṁ yudhi nirjitam ।। 6.49.5 ।।।।

translations.english: "Of what purpose is my life when I behold my brother lying lifeless in war? What do I have with Sita? Or even with my life?"
